review.method: Primary agent source/call-chain/diff review plus three user-authorized gpt-6.1-terra read-only reviews: Rust/MLS, server, frontend. Not an independent third-party security audit.
scope: Fastify routes, auth, CSRF, sessions and authorization
SQL schema, ACL, FK, indexes, transactions and lock order
MLS lab versus product, key and deletion lifecycles
Frontend API contracts, unknown outcomes and resource cleanup
Scripts, deployment, dependencies, licenses, links and sensitive patterns

issues.rootCause: Inbound message rejection was installed only after async authentication and row-lock waits.
issues.change: Install the sole message rejection synchronously; terminate on socket error.
issues.verification: TypeScript, ESLint, listener/attach call-chain review; WSS concurrency NOT_RUN.

issues.rootCause: Missing URL or port could select an unintended pg default target.
issues.change: Require explicit loopback PostgreSQL URL, port, echo_native_owner, echo_native, no query/fragment before connecting; 5s connect timeout. Exported migration helpers unchanged.
issues.verification: JS syntax, ESLint, installed pg parser and guard order review; no CLI/SQL/database execution.

issues.rootCause: 19-digit rename version could exceed PostgreSQL bigint and become a generic 500.
issues.change: Reuse existing bounded sequence validation before rename.
issues.verification: TypeScript, ESLint, route/service/schema tracing; HTTP NOT_RUN.

issues.rootCause: CAS failures retained stale versions without a recovery action.
issues.change: Refresh registration settings in finally; provide explicit account refresh while preserving the visible error.
issues.verification: TypeScript and Hooks ESLint, query refresh and remount tracing; NEEDS_RUNTIME_VERIFICATION.

issues.rootCause: Unknown registration outcome kept operation ID but reset input, allowing incompatible retries.
issues.change: Keep original username/invitation in current DOM and readonly, reuse operation ID, clear password after every attempt, permit original retry even after mode closes, require explicit confirmation for another registration. No persistence across reload/navigation.
issues.verification: TypeScript, Hooks ESLint, response-loss/login-toggle/mode-change source tracing and Terra re-review; NEEDS_RUNTIME_VERIFICATION.

issues.rootCause: Error fallback did not retain the normal page main-content location/focus contract.
issues.change: Preserve main ID and tabIndex in failure fallback.
issues.verification: TypeScript, AST and focus target reference; keyboard/screenreader NEEDS_RUNTIME_VERIFICATION.

issues.rootCause: Dead metrics/chart-observations styles remained after BoardUI migration.
issues.change: Remove only unreferenced rules; retain split-panels.
issues.verification: Repository references and formatting; final CSS size NOT_RUN.

issues.rootCause: Docs mixed old and current evidence and retained obsolete ID/dependency/CLI descriptions.
issues.change: Update required documents and evidence, preserve history, screenshots, licenses and blockers.
issues.verification: Format, local references, lock/SBOM/migration/screenshot hashes; final diff review.
